abstract:
BACKGROUND: Resection status is associated with overall survival among patients operated on for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). This study investigated whether the number of R1 margins is associated with shorter survival.
METHODS: Adult patients who underwent pancreatoduodenectomy for primary resectable PDAC between 2017 and 2024 recorded in the Swedish National Pancreatic Registry were included. Overall survival was analysed according to overall R status and the number of R1 margins. Overall survival was analysed using Kaplan-Meier estimates, Cox regression analysis for estimated adjusted survival time, and Laplace regression for analysis of percentile distribution.
RESULTS: Overall, 1043 patients were included, 398 patients (38.2%) with R0 and 645 patients (61.8%) with R1 margins. The adjusted median survival was 8.2 (95% confidence interval (c.i.) -12.0 to -4.3) months shorter for patients with R1 versus R0 margins, with a progressively shorter survival with a higher number of R1 margins. Specifically, compared with R0 margins, the adjusted median survival for one, two and three or more R1 margins was 4.6 (95% c.i. -10.2 to 1.0), 6.7 (95% c.i. -11.9 to -1.5), and 12.4 (95% c.i. -16.5 to -8.3) months shorter, respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: Patients with R1 margins had an adjusted median survival that was 8 months shorter than patients with R0 margins. An increased number of R1 margins was associated with shorter survival. These results suggest that the current practice of reporting binary R status is insufficient, and future guidelines should consider revising this routine and adopt a standardized, detailed margin assessment protocol.
key_points_ko: 췌십이지장절제술을 받은 췌장암 환자 1043명 중 R0 절제는 38.2%(398명), R1 절제는 61.8%(645명)였습니다.
R1 절제 환자의 보정된 중앙 생존기간은 R0 절제 환자보다 8.2개월(95% 신뢰구간 -12.0~-4.3개월) 유의하게 짧았습니다.
R0 절제 대비 보정된 중앙 생존기간은 침범 절제연이 1곳일 때 4.6개월, 2곳일 때 6.7개월, 3곳 이상일 때 12.4개월 더 짧아 침범 부위 수가 많을수록 예후가 나빴습니다.
summary_ko: 스웨덴 전국 췌장 등록부(2017~2024년)에 등록된 원발성 절제 가능 췌관선암(PDAC)으로 췌십이지장절제술을 받은 성인 환자 1043명을 분석한 연구입니다. 전체 환자 중 완전 절제(R0)는 38.2%(398명), 현미경적 잔존암이 있는 절제(R1)는 61.8%(645명)였습니다. R1 절제 환자는 R0 환자에 비해 보정된 중앙 생존기간이 8.2개월 더 짧았으며, 침범된 R1 절제연 수가 많을수록 생존기간이 점진적으로 짧아졌습니다. 연구진은 단순히 R0와 R1으로만 구분하는 기존 관행을 넘어, 절제연 침범 개수를 포함한 표준화되고 상세한 평가 프로토콜을 도입해야 한다고 제안했습니다.
title: Multiple R1 margins are associated with shorter overall survival: national register-based study on pancreatic cancer
